The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Furan]] led a small-time criminal organization that indulged in the theft of vehicles. Just prior to the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the crime spree of '''Furan's social club''' was brought to an end by the intervention of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Furan's social club's first and only mention is in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', the seventh novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. While the organization is merely mentioned in ''Conviction'', several of its members were briefly featured.
